        <api_name>x_938076_now_utils.MSSCustodyonDemandTrigger</api_name>
        <caller_access/>
        <client_callable>true</client_callable>
        <description>This script is called by the onLoad Client script on Trade table to generate the event for onDemand API calling.</description>
        <mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable>
        <name>MSSCustodyonDemandTrigger</name>
        <sandbox_callable>true</sandbox_callable>
        <script><![CDATA[var MSSCustodyonDemandTrigger = Class.create();
MSSCustodyonDemandTrigger.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {
    //     initialize: function() {
    //     },
   
    triggerevent: function(sysparm_recorded_sysid) {
        var tradeSysId = this.getParameter('sysparm_recorded_sysid');
        gs.info('MSSCustodyonDemandTrigger');
        var tradeRecord = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc_mss_custody_trade');
        tradeRecord.get(tradeSysId);
        gs.eventQueue('x_hsb11_mss_c_proc.event_layer_custody.o', tradeRecord);
        return;
    },

    type: 'MSSCustodyonDemandTrigger'
});]]></script>
